'''Lando Calrissian's sidearm blaster''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] wielded by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The small black pistol was carried by Calrissian in a shoulder [[Holster/Legends|holster]] while he served as a [[General/Legends|general]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Set Piece">{{InsiderCite|59|Set Piece|Set Piece: Rebel Alliance Briefing Room}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This blaster, seen holstered in {{Film|VI}}, was prominently seen in the hand of [[Billy Dee Williams]] in a number of promotional photos for the film<ref name="FF106">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 106|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 106]]</ref>, and recreated as an action figure accessory a number of times.<ref name="Saga">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|packtype='04 Basic Figure|pack=#21: Lando Calrissian (Death Star Attack)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw0421landogeneral.asp}}</ref><ref name="Vintage">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#047: Lando Calrissian|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/VC47-General-Lando-Calrissian-The-Vintage-Collection.asp}}</ref> The blaster prop was a modified Heckler & Koch P9S double-action pistol.<ref name="Set Piece" />
